learning_outcomes.text: Introduce nonlinear circuit elements and perform time and frequency domain analysis of nonlinear circuits.
Derive continuous-time and discrete-time state equations for nonlinear systems and design observers and controllers for these systems.

syllabus_topics: Fundamental definitions of circuit theory, matrix formulation of Kirchhoff's laws
Node analysis in nonlinear static circuits, computer-aided solution of nonlinear algebraic equations, general characteristics of nonlinear static circuits
Dynamic Systems and Derivation of State Equations
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course plan. Midterm and final exam dates are held on the dates specified in the academic calendar by the decision of our University Senate.
bibliography: L.O. Chua, C.A. Desoer, E.S. Kuh, Linear and Nonlinear Circuits, McGraw-Hill, 1987
"Nonlinear Systems" by Hassan K. Khalil, Prentice Hall, 2002
institution: Düzce University — Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği (Electrical-Electronics Engineering), Normal Öğretim
